{"claims":[{"claim_text":"America is committed to Israel's security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. will ensure Israel maintains a qualitative military edge over any and all adversaries.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. supports Israel's right and obligation to defend itself against terror attacks upon its people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. supports Israel's right and obligation to defend itself against alternative forms of warfare being waged legally, economically, culturally, and otherwise.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. rejects the notion that Israel is an occupier.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Boycott, Divestment, and Sanctions Movement (BDS) is anti-Semitic in nature and seeks to destroy Israel.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. calls for effective legislation to thwart actions intended to limit commercial relations with Israel, or persons or entities doing business in Israel or in Israeli-controlled territories, in a discriminatory manner.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. seeks to assist in the establishment of comprehensive and lasting peace in the Middle East, to be negotiated among those living in the region.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. opposes any measures intended to impose an agreement or to dictate borders or other terms in the Middle East.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. calls for the immediate termination of all U.S. funding of any entity that attempts to impose an agreement or dictate borders or other terms in the Middle East.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. stands with Israel now and always.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
